description: Fill in Media registration for a journalist or content creator (GCS media invitations and news). Same fields as the web form; see get_registration_form. Needs consent: true. They confirm by email; the media team then checks credentials.

agent_name.description: Optional: name of the AI assistant submitting this

consent.description: Must be true: the person agreed to register and be contacted by GCS

email.description: Their email; GCS sends the confirmation link here

events.description: Which GCS events they are interested in; values from get_registration_form

first-name.description: Given name of the person registering

message.description: Optional note to the GCS team

platform.description: Main platform or outlet type (e.g. online news, YouTube, podcast)

profile-link.description: Link to their author page, channel or portfolio

role.description: Their role; see get_registration_form for what each means

name: register_as_media
title: GCS media registration
